ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, approximately 20:80, with brightness concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white patches at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive grey-scale mottling across the central surface; distinct white linear streaks on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the continuous trailing edge; visible jagged peaks concentrated on the outer third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve with a tapered sweep towards the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a slight convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters of light pixels on dark backgrounds and dark pixels on light backgrounds located on the terminal ends of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense collection of parallel and intersecting dark-on-light and light-on-dark linear scratches (rake marks) across the entire visible ventral surface, most prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes; concentrated barnacle-induced scarring at the distal margins; small circular scar on the inner left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct crescent-shaped white scar located on the lower left ventral surface near the peduncle junction.
